meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成新成员快速上手的入门指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要帮新成员快速上手项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate a quick-start guide for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're welcoming new teammates and want them up to speed fast.

howto.what: 根据项目已有的知识图谱,为新成员生成一份入职指南。若图谱不存在,先提示运行 /understand。文档包含项目概览、架构分层、关键概念、导览路径、文件地图与复杂度热点,输出为 markdown,并询问是否保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md。
howto.when: 当用户需要为刚加入项目的新成员生成一份入职指南(onboarding guide)时触发。

say.text: 给刚加入项目的新成员生成一份入职指南
say.note: 按已有知识图谱生成完整入职文档。

say.text: 帮我写一份 onboarding 文档,包含架构分层和导览路径
say.note: 文档会列出架构分层与推荐阅读顺序。

say.text: 生成入职指南并保存到 docs/ONBOARDING.md
say.note: 技能会生成文档;保存前可能再次确认。

howto.what_en: Creates a new-hire onboarding guide from the project knowledge graph. If it is missing, asks to run /understand first. Outputs markdown, then offers to save to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for an onboarding guide for new members joining a project.

say_en.text: Create an onboarding guide for the new member joining the project.
say_en.note: Generates the full guide from the existing knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Write an onboarding doc with architecture layers and guided tour.
say_en.note: Outputs architecture layers and a recommended tour.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide and save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
say_en.note: Generates the doc first, then asks to save; confirm to write.
